# External link

<!-- Generated by php artisan standards:install from tey/standards; do not edit. -->

target=_blank links carry rel=noopener and the external-link icon.

Scaffold: `php artisan standards:make page --flavor=show <Name>`.

Kit: @kit/ui Button, @kit/ui DropdownLink.
- `Button` from `@kit/ui` for the external link: A link styled as a button, target _blank with rel noopener and the external icon (props: href, target, rel).
- `DropdownLink` from `@kit/ui` for the menu link: An external link inside a menu (props: href).
Checks: ui new-tab. Run `php artisan standards:check --changed` before committing.

Not sure this is the right leaf? It answers "Which kind of control?" Call bakery.find, or run `php artisan standards:pattern --recipe=ui-page.external-link` to see its siblings.
